channel.title: CTV News – Toronto City Hall
channel.description: Toronto City Hall coverage from CTV News Toronto.

item.title: First poll since Chris Alexander’s entrance into the Toronto mayoral race released. Here is what it reveals
Former federal cabinet minister enters Toronto mayor’s race, Bradford says he has ‘never heard’ of him
item.description: Former federal Conservative cabinet minister Chris Alexander has officially entered Toronto’s mayoral race, pitching himself as the “outsider” needed to get a city he says is “slightly adrift” back on track.

item.title: Former Conservative MP Chris Alexander to run for Toronto mayor
item.description: A former Conservative cabinet minister is throwing his name in the hat to be Toronto’s mayor.

item.title: Toronto mayor asks province to return island land after feds block airport expansion
item.description: Toronto Mayor Olivia Chow wants the land from the city’s islands back.

item.title: City councillor wants Toronto to consider making Sneaky Dee’s a heritage site
item.description: A Toronto city councillor wants Sneaky Dees to be considered for a heritage designation after the beloved venue staved off demolition when a redevelopment application fell through earlier this month.

item.title: Two city councillors push to temporarily rename Toronto street ‘BTS Boulevard’
item.description: Two Toronto city councillors are hoping to pass a “Dynamite” motion to temporarily rename a Toronto street after one of the world’s most popular boy bands, BTS.

item.title: Toronto could ban ‘surveillance pricing’ for groceries. Here is what that means.
item.description: Toronto Mayor Olivia Chow is putting forward a motion to stop the practice of “surveillance pricing” for groceries, which uses algorithms to determine the maximum price online shoppers are willing to pay for a product.

item.title: Toronto is looking to have more pedestrian-friendly streets. What could that look like?
item.description: Toronto is looking at having more pedestrian-friendly streets throughout the city, where people can walk arm-in-arm from store to restaurant without worrying about oncoming traffic or waiting for street lights to change.

item.title: Olivia Chow leading Brad Bradford in Toronto mayoral race but gap has tightened: poll
item.description: A new poll shows that Olivia Chow is maintaining her lead in the Toronto mayoral race against contender Brad Bradford, but the east end councillor is gaining ground.

item.title: ‘It’s dirty, it’s unsafe’: Toronto mayoral candidate Brad Bradford pitches cleaning up, renaming Sankofa Square
item.description: Brad Bradford says Sankofa Square was once the epicentre of the city, the “Canadian version” of Times Square and a place where people would celebrate festivals and gather with friends for a night out.

item.title: Should Rogers Stadium turn to a sound barrier amid noise complaints? One Toronto councillor thinks so
item.description: As concert noise at Rogers Stadium continues to be the source of frustration among residents around Downsview Park, one councillor wants venue operator Live Nation to find more ways to turn down the volume.

item.title: Drivers speeding well above posted limit has surged nearly 400 per cent since removal of automated cameras
item.description: Speeding in Toronto school and community safety zones has surged since the province ordered the removal of automated speed enforcement cameras, with the number of drivers travelling at least 16 km/h over the limit increasing by nearly 400 per cent, according to a new city report.

item.title: Municipal election could be turning point for non-profits fighting gentrification
item.description: A handful of Toronto community groups buying properties across the city in an effort to keep rents low say the upcoming municipal election could determine whether they’re able to secure thousands more units in the years to come as the ongoing demand for housing shifts focus.

item.title: Ex-Liberal MP Han Dong running for Toronto councillor in Scarborough North
item.description: Former Liberal Toronto MP Han Dong is running to become a Toronto city councillor.

item.title: Report says Billy Bishop airport expansion could impact thousands of homes along waterfront
item.description: A new report from city staff is warning that any expansion of Billy Bishop airport could result in major adverse impacts on housing, congestion, the environment and the waterfront as a whole.
